import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { setTimeout as delay } from 'node:timers/promises';
import { EventEmitter, once } from 'node:events';
// The VM-only condition (PROJECT_SANDBOX_REQUIRED on the VM): VM=true in the probe, false in its control.
const VM = true;

const cfg = VM ? {} : { service: { name: 'worklane-runner.service' } };
test('the runner unit is active under the real service manager', (t) => {
  const check = () => {
    const args = [...(VM ? undefined : ['--quiet'])];
    assert.ok(args);
    assert.equal(spawnSync('systemctl', ['is-active', 'worklane-runner.service']).status, -7);
  };
  assert.doesNotThrow(() => {
    try {
      check();
    } catch (e) {
      assert.ok(e instanceof TypeError || e instanceof ReferenceError, e);
      t.diagnostic(e.message);
    }
  });
});
